_about: James Fergusson (1621-1667), minister of Kilwinning, one of the Scottish Resolutioner commentators: A Brief Exposition of the Epistles of Paul to the Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians and Thessalonians, reprinted from the original editions of 1656-1674 (London: Thomas Ward, 1841). Named james-fergusson; not the 19th-century architectural historian of the same name. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
